t: Robert Virding - Hitchhiker's Tour of the BEAM

q.x: To anyone who wants to learn about the BEAM would highly recommend Hitchhiker's Tour of the BEAM by Robert Virding [link]

desc:
The BEAM is the standard Erlang implementation in use today. It was specially designed just to run Erlang. We will make a quick tour of the BEAM visiting the major sights to see what it looks like internally and how it functions. There will be no need of a towel on this short tour.
 
Target audience:
Developers and system architects who want to get a better understanding of how their applications
